Q5543.reason: Sprint ADP/AMP breakdown yields ammonia plus the purine products hypoxanthine and uric acid; urea and creatine/creatinine are not direct ADP-degradation products.

Q5544.reason: Peristomal excoriation is classically caused by effluent leaking onto the skin; a good fit, daily changes, and unscented soap do not cause it.

Q5546.reason: Soot that discolors the house is a physical invasion with actual damage, so trespass fits better than strict liability, unproven negligence, or a one-time nuisance.
